candidate.universe: stocks with at least one qualifying overnight TDnet disclosure on a source-complete target session
candidate.bundle: join the code's qualifying titles in publication-time order with the frozen separator

target.name: open_to_close_return_pct
target.training_clip: training-period 1st and 99th percentiles, followed by [-10,+10] percentage points

decision.allocation: 100% of the research sleeve to the selected shadow candidate

forbidden_during_window: change n-gram range or vectorizer settings
change Ridge alpha or target clipping
select a threshold after observing outcomes
silently treat missing TDnet pages as no event

point_in_time_contract.missing_source_policy: fail closed and record no candidate

evaluation.primary_metric: mean daily net return at 40 bps with cash on no-candidate days
required_reports: top 10 profit-contributing codes replaced by cash net20
paired difference versus frozen L4 comparator
realized spread, slippage, turnover, and minimum-lot feasibility when available

requirements: at least 120 source-complete sessions spanning at least 4 calendar months
net40 is positive in both chronological halves
one-sided paired 90% lower bound versus frozen L4 is at least zero
candidate generation and PIT compliance are both at least 98%
minimum-lot, spread, slippage, and turnover checks show the strategy is executable
promotion_gate_after_window.failure_action: retain as research or reject; do not tune on the same forward window
